## Problem statement

A clear description of the problem this feature would solve.  
_Example: "I always have to scroll through the entire menu to find veg items..."_

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other solutions or features you considered and why they wouldn't work as well.

## Who would benefit

- [ ] Clients (students)
- [ ] Vendors (mess owners)
- [ ] Administrators

## Additional context

Any mockups, screenshots, or external references that support this request.
